help.title: Help & Contact
help.subtitle: Quick guide to using GarageLedger and support information.

sections.title: Getting started
sections.body: GarageLedger is an offline-first garage/auto trading system. Your data is stored locally on your PC and is backed up automatically (daily) when the app is opened.
bullets: Use Settings to change language, currency and theme
Use Inventory for day-to-day operations (buy, reserve, sell)
Use Reports to export a branded PDF for a date range

sections.title: Add / edit a vehicle (Inventory)
sections.body: Go to Inventory → New Trade. Fill vehicle details, category and purchase information. You can always edit a trade later from the Inventory table.
bullets: Vehicle: brand, model, year, engine
Purchase: date and purchase price
Parties: select a seller/buyer from CRM or add instantly

sections.title: Statuses: In stock / Reserved / Sold
sections.body: Every trade has a status that controls what data is required and how it is reported.
bullets: In stock: purchase is recorded, no sale info yet
Reserved: reserve date + expected sale price + deposit (optional)
Sold: sale date + payment details and receivable tracking

sections.title: Selling a vehicle: payment methods
sections.body: When marking a vehicle as Sold, choose a payment method. The form changes dynamically based on your selection.
bullets: Cash: full amount received, remaining balance becomes 0
Installment: sale price + down payment + installment count; remaining and monthly amount are calculated
Trade-in (Barter): cash received + trade-in vehicle details and trade-in value

sections.title: Trade-in (Barter): automatic stock entry
sections.body: When a sale is completed with Trade-in, the trade-in vehicle is automatically added to Inventory as a new In stock trade.
bullets: Trade-in value becomes the purchase price of the new stock item
Seller of the trade-in item is set to the buyer of the sold vehicle
You can edit the newly created stock item later to add details/expenses

sections.title: Pending payments & reminders
sections.body: If a sold trade has remaining balance > 0, it appears on Dashboard under Pending Payments & Reminders.
bullets: Collect: subtract a received amount from remaining balance (removed from the list when it reaches 0)
Snooze: move the next payment date by 1 day, 3 days or 1 week
Use next payment date to keep receivables visible and never miss a collection

sections.title: Expenses & true profit
sections.body: Use the Expenses section inside a trade to record all operational costs related to a vehicle.
bullets: Each expense: date, description, amount
Net Profit (sold): sale price − (purchase price + total expenses)
Use consistent expense entries for accurate reporting and analytics

sections.title: Reports & PDF export
sections.body: Go to Reports to view movements and export a high-quality PDF with summary totals and a table.
bullets: Date presets: Today, This Week, This Month, Last 30 Days, Custom
Summary includes total investment, revenue and net profit (for sold items)
Export options: language, currency, date format, A4/Letter and Light/Dark PDF
PDF is branded with header and Cicibyte Corp footer

sections.title: CRM (Customers): people & profiles
sections.body: Customers is a standalone CRM module. You can add people manually and open a profile view at any time.
bullets: Create a person: name, phone, email, role and notes
Profile shows: total volume, remaining receivable and transaction list
Use CRM selection when buying/selling instead of typing names manually

sections.title: Backups, restore & updates
sections.body: GarageLedger protects your data with backups and supports auto-update via GitHub releases.
bullets: Backups: automatic daily backups + manual backup/restore from Settings
Updates: use Settings → Check for Updates, then restart when downloaded
If you are behind on versions, ensure you installed the Setup (.exe) build (not a copied folder)
